entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. I wanted to thank you again for approving my plans for Autonomous Bergia. However, the Assembly denied us the possibility."

entries.dialogueText: "The proposal only received about 90 votes."

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry but what did you expect? The Grand National Assembly did the right thing."

entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Mr. President. I wanted to thank y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. I wanted to thank you again for approving my plans for the centralization of Bergia. However, the Assembly denied us the possibility."

entries.dialogueText: "Of course, this isn't very unexpected, judging by your popularity among the party."

entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You could have passed it by decree..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could have passed it by decree if you hadn't completely removed them."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You could have passed it by decree..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could have passed it by decree but you made the Assembly block it instead."

entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, this was a huge disappointment."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lileas, I appreciate your dedicati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lileas, I appreciate your dedication and the effort you put into those plans. I understand your frustration, but we must respect the democratic process."

entries.title: Player: ""Instead of expressing our disappoi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Instead of expressing our disappointment, let's learn from this. We must improve our approach and build consensus."

entries.dialogueText: She simply nodded.
